title: Scoped nested tag branch rename and merge
intendedEntrypoint: Workbench Tags: selected-item branch rename/merge controls
behavior: Maps exact prefix boundaries once, preserves descendant suffixes and tag types; existing destination metadata wins merges; protects status/rating tags and rejects cross-library selections.
tests: R01 branch rename merges existing destinations without losing types or sibling tags
R01 exact rename and scoped guards prevent subtree and cross-library changes
R01 moving a branch below itself maps each original suffix once and rolls back batch failure
redEvidence: Before implementation:18 pass,2 fail (new API absent).
expertReview: Confirmed native getTags/setTags and reused transactional differential rollback.
adversarialReview: Tested descendant-target rename without cascading, target collision metadata, and later-item save failure rolling earlier changes back.
reference: Local Zotero Item tag API; original implementation, no protected code copied.

title: Guarded bulk annotation recoloring
behavior: Validates six-digit colors and library identity, checks clean/editable annotation attachment and parent, skips unchanged colors, and saves transactionally.
tests: R02 recolor validates complete parent chain before changing annotation color
R02 failed bulk recolor preserves newer annotation comments and user colors
R02 a parent becoming dirty mid-batch aborts later recolors without discarding parent edits
redEvidence: Before implementation:21 pass,2 fail (new API absent).
expertReview: Read Zotero item.js annotationColor setter, annotation/annotationDeferred loaders and field-specific _clearChanged behavior.
adversarialReview: Later save failure preserves concurrently edited comments/colors; a parent becoming dirty between saves aborts and rolls back annotations without touching parent drafts.
reference: Local Zotero Item annotation API; native saves retain existing quote text, comments, positions and source keys.

title: Symmetric selected related-link removal
intendedEntrypoint: Workbench selected papers: remove related links among selection
behavior: Deletes only selected-item URI links under Zotero related-item predicate; preserves links to other papers and all other relation predicates. Handles one-sided links, requires same-library editable clean regular items.
tests: R03 selected relation removal is symmetric and preserves other links and predicates
R03 relation removal rejects cross-library input and restores links after later failure
R03 unlink handles one-sided edges and retains concurrent unrelated edits on rollback
redEvidence: Before implementation:24 pass,2 fail (new API absent).
expertReview: Confirmed Zotero removeRelatedItem delegates to relatedItemPredicate + exact ItemURI; used full getRelations/setRelations to preserve unrelated predicates.
adversarialReview: Verified one-sided edge removal and concurrent unrelated relation additions survive a later unlink-save failure.
reference: Local Zotero item.js removeRelatedItem and dataObject.js relation API.

title: Explicit direct and recursive collection scope
intendedEntrypoint: Workbench scope selector: current collection with optional descendants
behavior: Requires explicit chosen library, returns regular undeleted collection members, deduplicates recursive descendants, yields between chunks and never changes default library scope.
tests: R04 collection scope returns deduplicated direct or recursive regular item IDs
R04 collection scope rejects foreign descendants and terminates cycles
R04 querying another library collection does not change default note scope
redEvidence: Before implementation:27 pass,2 fail (new API absent).
expertReview: Confirmed getChildItems(false,false)/getChildCollections(false,false) return native objects; load child data before access.
adversarialReview: Rejects foreign descendant/membership corruption, terminates cycles, excludes deleted/attachment records and preserves other-library note scope.
reference: Local Zotero Collection data-loading and child traversal APIs.

title: Exact annotation-to-note backlinks
intendedEntrypoint: Workbench annotation backlinks and native annotation-header backlink actions (R14)
behavior: Matches native data-annotation attachmentURI+annotationKey pairs and scoped select/open-pdf annotation links, decoding escaped/URI-encoded attributes. Does not confuse different annotations sharing a PDF.
tests: R13 annotation backlinks distinguish two highlights in the same attachment
R13 annotation backlinks accept escaped metadata and reject group or annotation-key collisions
R13 malformed or ambiguous annotation references and quoted markup do not create backlinks
redEvidence: Before implementation:30 pass,2 fail (paper-oriented backlinks missed exact annotation references).
expertReview: Verified native EditorInstanceUtilities.serializeAnnotations stores attachmentURI and annotationKey in URI-encoded data-annotation attributes.
adversarialReview: Rejects wrong-group/same-key links, same-PDF different annotation references, conflicting query parameters, invalid JSON and markup quoted as note text.
reference: Local Zotero editorInstance.js serializeAnnotations; Style reference labels specify annotation-to-note backlinks.

title: Geometry-preserving selected annotation paragraph merge (library service)
intendedEntrypoint: Native reader selected-annotation merge action implemented by reader leaf; root combines as one R15 round
behavior: Retains first annotation in page/sortIndex order, combines all rectangle positions across same or two adjacent pages via native nextPageRects, joins paragraph text/comments and merges tags; soft-deletes extras only after survivor save inside one DB transaction. Rejects external/read-only/dirty/mixed-PDF/mixed-type/mixed-color/malformed selections.
tests: R15 adjacent-page merge preserves geometry, paragraphs, comments and tags in reading order
R15 merge rejects stale, external, mismatched or unsupported selections without writes
R15 failure trashing an extra annotation rolls back survivor geometry and recoverable deletion
R15 combines existing next-page rectangles and refuses three-page or malformed geometry
R15 rollback preserves edits made to the survivor while an extra save fails
R15 reader change after survivor save rolls back before deleting the other annotation
redEvidence: Before implementation:33 pass,3 fail (new API absent).
expertReview: Read installed Zotero app/omni.ja resource/reader/reader.js: nextPageRects explicitly maps pageIndex+1. Verified native annotation setters and recoverable deleted-item save semantics.
adversarialReview: Tests invalid geometry/three-page spans, reversed input order, existing two-page source rectangles, stale reader after survivor save, later deletion failure and concurrent survivor comment/tag edits.
limitations: Only highlights or underlines with identical type/color and at most two adjacent pages; surplus annotations remain recoverable in Trash. Existing notes referencing surplus annotation keys are not rewritten.
reference: Native Zotero PDF rectangle/nextPageRects schema and annotation save APIs; original merge implementation, no protected code copied.
